_comment: Star Sports only — English HD + Tamil. Everything else in the source file is filtered out by onlyNames. Edit freely; the workflow re-runs and re-validates.
title: Star Sports — English HD + Tamil
_keepQualityVariants: true = an HD feed and its SD/Digital sibling both stay in the file (map them as alternatives of one channel in the app). false = only the best row per channel survives.
_onlyNames: Allowlist. Case-insensitive regex, tested against the raw channel name and against the de-duplication name. Delete a line to drop that channel; add a line to let another one through. Nothing else can ever enter the file.
_bigbossPattern: Unused here (the section is off) — kept so the builder config stays compatible with the main feed.
_nameAliases: Empty on purpose: each of the six feeds must keep its own row.
_dropHosts: Hosts known to answer 403/500 for everyone — rows on them are dead weight.
_sources: This repo builds from its OWN verified file (star-sports.m3u at the repo root), so the feed is deterministic and independent of the Sportlink upstreams. Add more sources here if you ever want to.
